paragraphs: 2 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Saturday for 2 clubs, with Andrew Alvarez producing the night's most notable performance.
Andrew Alvarez started on the mound for Washington Nationals.
Andrew Alvarez worked 6.0 innings, allowing 5 hits and 0 earned runs, with 1 walk and 8 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the first on a 0-2 86 mph curveball, when he put away Masyn Winn.
Washington Nationals beat St. Louis Cardinals, 8-5.

Brooks Lee went 1-for-5, 1 double, 1 run scored for Minnesota Twins. Brooks Lee produced a double in the fourth to left field on a 3-1 93 mph four-seam fastball from Reid Detmers. He batted fifth and started at third base. Minnesota Twins fell to Los Angeles Angels, 5-6.
title: Andrew Alvarez turns in a strong outing on the mound
